comment: 38yo female, 5 years post-allogeneic HSCT (for refractory ALL, 2021), on chronic systemic immunosuppression (tacrolimus + low-dose prednisone) for ongoing limited chronic GVHD (skin + oral). Chronic immunosuppression ≥1y documented + ≥3y post-transplant — sits in BOTH the upstream universal-immunocompromised cohort AND the chronic-iatrogenic-transplant-immunosuppression-≥3y cohort. No current malignancy. Allogeneic HSCT recipients on chronic immunosuppression carry elevated risk of: post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (late-onset PTLD, often EBV-negative DLBCL-like histology); cumulative cutaneous SCC (65-100x background) + BCC (10-20x); HPV-associated cervical + anal disease; oropharyngeal SCC; HHV-8-driven Kaposi if HHV-8-exposed. Engine fires RF-UNIVERSAL-IMMUNOCOMPROMISED-CANCER-RISK (chronic_immunosuppression_ge_1y_documented:true; relevant_diseases:['*'] — sidecar documentation per plan.py exclusion) AND RF-IATROGENIC-TRANSPLANT-IMMUNOSUPPRESSION-LONGTERM-PREVENTION (any_of: post_solid_organ_transplant_immunosuppression_ge_3y OR post_allogeneic_hsct_chronic_immunosuppression_ge_3y OR years_post_transplant_ge_3_on_immunosuppression). Routes to multi-cancer surveillance PreventionPlan: standard = annual full-skin exam with dermatologist + cervical co-test q1-3y + anal cytology if HPV-history + dental cancer screening q12mo + EBV-VL surveillance + HPV vaccination catch-up + coordinated immunosuppression-minimization with transplant team (NEVER unilateral); alternative = standard-cadence surveillance with symptom-triggered escalation. Validates v0.3 universal-immunocompromised pilot — HSCT chronic-cohort axis. Sister to existing patient_chronic_lymphocytic_immunosuppression.json (50yo MDS post-HSCT 7y); this patient is younger (38yo), shorter latency (5y), ALL-indication HSCT.
